title: Plant dashboard
summary: Telemetry from a fictional plant: 8 machines, 72 widgets on high-rate sensor data, built native, native with workers, and on Isoloop in several placements.

result.line: Blocking one widget for 3 s stalls the whole native page and loses 3.8 s of data; in Isoloop's default placement the widgets' pool restarts and no data is lost. On a desktop that placement costs +11 to +19 points of CPU and +41 to +51 MB against native with workers.
